## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block, 7C:0C:F6, to "Guangdong Huiwei High-tech Co., Ltd." at an address in the Puzhai New Area of Fengshun County, Meizhou, Guangdong, China [1]. A third-party lookup gives the block's registration date as 25 June 2018 and records no later update [2]. The registrant is a different company from Huawei, whose blocks include the neighbouring prefix 7C:0C:FA, so the similar name is not evidence of a Huawei device [2][3].

No company website, product, FCC grantee code or teardown naming this registrant could be found by web searches in English and Chinese, so what a device in this block is, its radios and its silicon are all unknown, and the kind is given as other for want of any documented product line. Nothing is filled in from memory.
